Title: Verify 'Sold Out' badge overlay on Brown Shades in catalog grid
Preconditions: User has network access to storefront catalog
Steps: 1. Open browser and navigate to /collections/all\n2. Locate the Brown Shades product card in the catalog grid\n3. Verify presence of 'SOLD OUT' overlay badge and £20.00 price tag
Expected Result: Catalog grid displays 'Brown Shades' with £20.00 price and a prominent 'SOLD OUT' badge overlay
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/collections/all | Product: Brown Shades | Expected Badge: SOLD OUT | Price: £20.00
